headline: Visa pilots AI agents completing invoice payments through supplier portals
body: Visa said the collaboration is the first live pilot to allow AI agents "to initiate and complete approved buyer invoice payments end-to-end through supplier portals." Visa's release says the authorized BILL Payment Agent is registered using Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol and Agentic Directory, and uses tokenized payment credentials.
note: Agent payments here are invoices between businesses, and the open question is how many supplier portals will accept agent authentication.

evidence.text: The collaboration is the first live pilot to allow artificial intelligence (AI) agents “to initiate and complete approved buyer invoice payments end-to-end through supplier portals,” Visa said in a news release provided to PYMNTS Tuesday (Oct. 20).

“The flow begins when the authorized BILL Payment Agent — registered using Visa’s Trusted Agent Protocol and Agentic Directory — uses tokenized payment credentials and controls aligned with the buyer’s approved payment instructions to issue payments on behalf of BILL’s customers,” the release added.
